Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL ID CHEMBL1075189 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
